_comment: Yolo-but-guarded profile, from ai/templates/claude.settings.json. Autonomy is granted here, and holds only while the execution policy (ai/00) is honoured. The deny list protects the generated baselines named in AGENTS.md's Bindings, forbids force-pushes, and forbids writes to other repositories. Commands that touch the cluster or the tailnet servers always ask first, as the user's own rules require. Only the user changes this file.
